flashcard_questions.q: Erosion that cuts downwards into the river bed, deepening the channel.
Ridges of hard rock that project out on alternating sides of a valley, around which the river winds.
A sudden descent of a river over a vertical or very steep slope, formed where hard rock overlies softer rock.

flashcard_questions.a: Erosion caused by rocks and sediment scraping against the river bed and banks.
The force of water hitting the river banks and bed, compressing air in cracks and breaking the rock apart.
